name: ohdear
description: A Pulumi provider for Oh Dear: manage monitors, status pages, tags, and notification destinations.

apiToken.description: Oh Dear API token, sent as a Bearer token on every request. Defaults to the OHDEAR_API_TOKEN environment variable.

clickable.description: Whether the entry links to the monitor's detail page. Default false.

id.description: Monitor ID to show on the page.

ohdear:index:CronCheck.description: An Oh Dear cron job monitor. Curl `pingUrl` from the job on success.

createdAt.description: When the cron check was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

cronCheckId.description: Numeric Oh Dear cron check ID.

cronExpression.description: For "cron" checks: crontab expression for when a ping is expected.

frequencyInMinutes.description: For "simple" checks: how often a ping is expected.

graceTimeInMinutes.description: How long a ping may be late before the check alerts.

monitorId.description: Monitor this cron check belongs to. Immutable — the API cannot move a check between monitors.

name.description: Display name for the cron check.

pingUrl.description: URL the job must request on each successful run.

serverTimezone.description: For "cron" checks: timezone the expression is evaluated in, e.g. Europe/Berlin.

type.description: One of "simple" (uses frequencyInMinutes) or "cron" (uses cronExpression + serverTimezone).

uuid.description: Stable UUID for the cron check; part of the ping URL.

name.description: Display name for the cron check.

ohdear:index:NotificationDestination.description: An Oh Dear notification destination for a team, monitor, tag or tag group.

destination.description: Channel-specific settings, e.g. { url: ... } for a webhook, { channel: ... } for Slack. Values are strings; use "true"/"false" for booleans such as Opsgenie's euEndpoint. Secret; kept from inputs on refresh.

destinationId.description: Numeric Oh Dear notification destination ID.

disabledReason.description: Why Oh Dear disabled the destination, if it did (e.g. repeated delivery failures).

enabled.description: Whether the destination is active. Default true; toggled via the enable/disable endpoints.

notificationTypes.description: Event types that trigger a notification (uptime, certificate_health, ...). Empty means all.

ownerId.description: ID of the owning team, monitor, tag or tag group.

destination.description: Channel-specific settings, e.g. { url: ... } for a webhook, { channel: ... } for Slack. Values are strings; use "true"/"false" for booleans such as Opsgenie's euEndpoint. Secret; kept from inputs on refresh.

enabled.description: Whether the destination is active. Default true; toggled via the enable/disable endpoints.

notificationTypes.description: Event types that trigger a notification (uptime, certificate_health, ...). Empty means all.

ownerId.description: ID of the owning team, monitor, tag or tag group.

ohdear:index:RecurringMaintenancePeriod.description: An Oh Dear recurring maintenance schedule that generates maintenance periods on a cadence.

createdAt.description: When the schedule was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

dayOfMonth.description: Day for a monthly schedule, 1 to 31.

daysOfWeek.description: Days for a weekly schedule, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).

lastGeneratedUntil.description: Date through which concrete maintenance periods have been generated (ISO 8601).

monitorId.description: Monitor this schedule applies to. Accepted only on create; immutable afterwards.

name.description: Display name for the recurring schedule.

recurringMaintenancePeriodId.description: Numeric Oh Dear recurring maintenance period ID.

updatedAt.description: When the schedule was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

dayOfMonth.description: Day for a monthly schedule, 1 to 31.

daysOfWeek.description: Days for a weekly schedule, 0 (Sunday) to 6 (Saturday).

monitorId.description: Monitor this schedule applies to. Accepted only on create; immutable afterwards.

name.description: Display name for the recurring schedule.

ohdear:index:StatusPage.description: An Oh Dear status page. `monitors` is the full set of monitors shown on the page.

badgeId.description: ID used to build the status badge image URL.

createdAt.description: When the page was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

domain.description: Custom domain serving the page, if configured.

fullUrl.description: Fully-qualified URL of the status page.

monitors.description: Full set of monitors shown on the page; syncing this list replaces the previous set.

slug.description: URL slug on the Oh Dear-hosted domain.

statusPageId.description: Numeric Oh Dear status page ID.

summarizedStatus.description: Current overall status shown on the page.

teamId.description: Team that owns the page. Immutable — no API endpoint edits the page itself, so a change replaces it.

timezone.description: Timezone the page renders times in.

title.description: Status page title. Immutable, same reason as teamId.

updatedAt.description: When the page was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

monitors.description: Full set of monitors shown on the page; syncing this list replaces the previous set.

teamId.description: Team that owns the page. Immutable — no API endpoint edits the page itself, so a change replaces it.

title.description: Status page title. Immutable, same reason as teamId.

ohdear:index:Tag.description: An Oh Dear tag. The API cannot update or delete tags: changing an input replaces the resource, and destroy only removes it from Pulumi state.

createdAt.description: When the tag was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

monitors.description: IDs of monitors to attach the tag to.

sites.description: IDs of the sites/monitors currently carrying the tag.

slug.description: URL-safe form of the tag name.

updatedAt.description: When the tag was last updated, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

monitors.description: IDs of monitors to attach the tag to.

ohdear:index:TagGroup.description: An Oh Dear tag group. `tags` holds tag names and supports wildcards such as `prod-*`.

createdAt.description: When the tag group was created, as an ISO 8601 timestamp.

groupId.description: Numeric Oh Dear tag group ID.

tags.description: Tag names in the group; wildcards such as prod-* are allowed.

teamId.description: Team that owns the tag group.

tags.description: Tag names in the group; wildcards such as prod-* are allowed.
